name: WAN Widget for UniFi
author: Fergus Stevens
description: Live WAN throughput, monthly usage, public IP, uptime and latency from your UniFi gateway, in the Omarchy bar. Needs curl and openssl; talks only to your gateway (and an IP lookup service, if enabled).

barWidget.description: WAN download and upload rates with a throughput graph, usage, IP, uptime and latency.

schema.label: Gateway address
schema.description: https://host, or https://host:11443 for UniFi OS Server.

schema.label: Site
schema.description: The site id from the UniFi API, usually default.

schema.label: Billing day
schema.description: Day of the month your ISP's month starts. Uses this PC's timezone.

schema.label: Public IP lookup URL
schema.description: Used to show your real public IP behind CGNAT. Leave empty to disable.
